_about: IFRIC 12 construction revenue of the international airport peers, curated from their filings for the ex-IFRIC 12 EBITDA margin column of the peers tables (GAP, ASUR, OMA). The Mexican groups need no entry: scripts/lib/factset-peers.mjs sums the construction revenue of the quarters in site/<slug>/data/financials.js over FactSet's LTM period. Each entry covers one LTM period and carries the components it was built from; the builder prints the column only while the snapshot's ltm.period equals `period`, otherwise the cell says the figure is pending. Amounts in the company's currency, millions. `applies: false` = owner-operator with no service concession, construction revenue zero by construction (the adjustment is nil, not pending).
